note: Behavioural evals to append to evals/cases/planning-and-task-breakdown.json for E1. Fixtures: evals/fixtures/planning-progress-format/ (an approved SPEC.md with front matter) and evals/fixtures/planning-progress-format-existing/ (a tasks/todo.md with T1-T3, T1 done).

evals.prompt: The spec in SPEC.md is approved. Break it into a plan and a task list.
evals.expected_output: tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md in the progress format: front matter, a Status line per task, stable T<n> ids, T<n> dependencies
expectations: tasks/todo.md starts with front matter holding plan and created (YYYY-MM-DD)
Every '## Task N:' heading is followed by a '**Status:** todo' line
Dependencies are written as T<n> ids or None
tasks/plan.md starts with front matter holding status: draft and created
Open questions in tasks/plan.md are numbered Q<n> and name the tasks they block
No checkbox is ticked and no task is marked in progress during planning

evals.prompt: Add a task for audit logging to the existing plan.
evals.expected_output: A new task T4 appended with its own Status line; T1-T3 keep their numbers, boxes and Status lines
expectations: The new task is numbered 4; no existing task is renumbered
The new task has a '**Status:** todo' line under its heading
T1's '**Status:** done' line and dates are unchanged
